snippet.title: Kurohyou 2 (Black Panther, Yakuza PSP Spinoff) Localisation Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
TeamK4L are proud to announce a complete English (and unofficial) localisation for the second Yakuza PSP game.

Coming 7th of January, 2022!

For more info, check out our twitter at: https://twitter.com/TeamK4L
